title:
Real images.
Built by AI.
Fixed by you.
say: In part two, an AI builds a deck from a real microscopy image. Then we fix the model's mistakes in the mask editor, step by step.

title: Ask your AI for a deck
say: Here's the prompt. I gave Claude a real image of human nuclei together with the mask from a simple threshold model. Using the Hooman skill, it cut the image into tiles wherever the model made mistakes and drew the model's outlines on them. Then it checked the deck against the app's rules and handed me a zip file.

title: Import the zip
say: On the phone, tap Import deck and pick the zip. Each card is one tile of the image with the model's outlines in red.

title: Spot the mistakes
say: Look closely. Some small nuclei have no outline at all. On the left, several nuclei are stuck together as one object. That needs fixing, so swipe up.

title: Start from the model
say: Start from model copies the model's outlines into the editor. Every object gets its own number and colour, so you only fix what's wrong.

title: Cut merged nuclei apart
say: Choose cut and draw a line across the narrow neck between two nuclei. The object splits in two and each part keeps its own number.

title: Add the missed nuclei
say: Now for the nuclei the model missed. Choose the wand and tap each one. It fills the bright area in a single tap, and the slider makes the last fill smaller or bigger.

title: Touch up by hand
say: For fine work, the brush paints the selected object without spilling into its neighbours. The eraser removes pixels, and undo and redo cover every step.

title: Save, then export
say: When you save, the corrected mask is stored with your answer. The exported zip holds every mask. It also records which objects came from the model and what you changed.

title: Back to your AI
say: Give the export back to the AI. It reads your corrected masks and counts what you fixed. They're ready to use as training data for a better model.

title:
Tracking, review
and your own answers
say: In part three we'll track cells over time, review our answers and make the answer buttons our own.
